title: Amrutam Kuntal Care Hair Spa | Do-it yourself Hair Treatment
description: Amrutam Kuntal Care Do-It-Yourself Hair Spa is your go-to for transformative hair with a little effort. DIY with this revitalizing formula rich in Ayurvedic herbs formulated for stronger, shinier & healthier hair.
highlights: Reduces hair fall by 50% in 4 weeks
howToUse: Mix the paste with lukewarm water to form a smooth paste. Apply evenly on scalp and hair. Leave for 30-45 minutes. Rinse thoroughly with Kuntal Care Herbal Shampoo.

faqs.question: How often should I use this product?
faqs.answer: For best results, use once a week as a deep conditioning treatment.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for all hair types?
faqs.answer: Yes, this hair spa is formulated to work on all hair types including dry, oily, and normal hair.
